command: import copy,json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); before=(copy.deepcopy(rs),copy.deepcopy(p)); got=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; assert got==json.load(open('report.json')); assert (rs,p)==before; assert evaluate({'from':'x','to':'y'},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}; assert evaluate({'from':'ready','to':'running','retry':True,'attempts':0},p)['reason']=='permission'; assert evaluate({'from':'draft','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':True},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'; assert evaluate({'from':'draft','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':2},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'; assert evaluate({'from':'draft','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':1},p)=={'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}; print('checks passed')

arguments.text: Implemented work.py evaluate(request, policy): supplied-policy edge lookup, blocked missing edges, role enforcement before retry validation, strict non-bool integer attempts in [0,retry_limit), exact schema outputs, and no input mutation. Generated report.json for current requests/policy. Local assertions cover report parity, immutability, blocked, permission precedence, bool/boundary retry rejection, and valid retry.
